verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a public API for driving Figma Make programmatically. A community report says Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, forcing reverse-engineering, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The MCP connection in docs-16 only lets Make pull in context from other tools, which is a client-side adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
